inputs.goal: settle sync vs async order processing under a 200ms p99 constraint

options.name: synchronous_order_processing
options.details: Guarantees immediate response within 200ms p99 but may block system resources under high load

options.name: asynchronous_order_processing
options.details: Provides better scalability and resource utilization but introduces latency risk beyond 200ms p99 threshold

rubric.sync_advantages: Immediate user feedback, simpler error handling
rubric.sync_disadvantages: Resource contention, potential blocking under load
rubric.async_disadvantages: Complexity in error recovery, potential timeout risks
rubric.decision_reasoning: Sync processing meets 200ms p99 requirement consistently with proper queuing mechanisms
